questions.prompt: Which command establishes an integration between 'web-app' and 'db'?
questions.explanation: 'juju integrate' (or 'juju relate') connects two applications via compatible endpoints.

questions.prompt: How do you sever an existing relation between 'web-app' and 'db'?
questions.explanation: 'juju remove-relation <app1> <app2>' breaks the integration and fires teardown events.

questions.prompt: Which command displays a table of all active relations in the current model?
questions.explanation: 'juju relations' lists all active regular, peer, and cross-model relations.
